title: AI Video Portfolio Maker for LinkedIn, Resumes & Pitch Decks
excerpt: Turn your resume, slides, or LinkedIn profile into a polished AI portfolio video with talking avatars and voice-over. No camera, no editing - share in minutes.
content_html:
Turn your expertise into LinkedIn-ready portfolio videos, video resumes, personal brand content, and pitch decks with AI talking avatars. No camera needed.

Your work, story, and voice, packaged as AI video contentBuilt for creators, job seekers, founders, consultants, and sales teams

Gabrielle

Music Marketing & Fan Engagement Specialist

Ryan

Senior Mechanical & Manufacturing Engineer

Sean Orr

Chief Medical Officer at The Neurogenesis Project

CTO | Manufacturing | Retail

Everyone has a story, but few turn it into a repeatable LinkedIn video content portfolio. PortfolioVideo helps creators, consultants, and professionals explain their expertise through short personal brand videos for LinkedIn, YouTube, websites, and outreach.

Use AI talking avatars, voice-over, and clean design to create clips that act like a creator portfolio: introductions, thought leadership, case studies, service explainers, and profile videos without filming every post from scratch.

Investors see hundreds of decks. Most look the same. But a video pitch deck? That’s different. Our AI pitch deck generator turns plain slides into dynamic storytelling - short, focused, emotional. It’s like having your best presenter speak, every single time, without you being there.

Perfect for founders and sales teams who need to make an impression fast. Create your next startup pitch video or elevator pitch video in minutes - clean visuals, natural delivery, and no video editing drama. It’s simple, sharp, and made to be remembered.

You’ve got the skills. Now show the person behind them. Our AI video resume builder makes it easy to craft a short, professional video resume that feels human. Upload your file, pick your style, and watch as the AI talking avatar brings your story to life.

The system works like magic - fast, affordable, and surprisingly personal. You can create video resume online free, build a sleek portfolio, and even experiment with a video CV maker online for that final touch. A few minutes of setup can change how recruiters see you - and that’s the difference between missed and noticed.

It’s simple, really. You upload your file and photo - that’s it. Our system does the heavy lifting. It turns those inputs into a clean, professional video - complete with scenes, voice narration, and your personal touch. No editing. No tech skills. Just your story, brought to life.

1. Doc and Photo Upload.

Start by picking what you want to create - maybe a short video pitch deck, a professional video resume, or even a personal branding video. Then, upload your document and a clear front photo. Our AI talking avatar studies your input, sets up the scenes, and starts generating your video automatically. Two uploads. One click. Endless possibilities.

2. AI-Powered Scene Generation

Once your file’s in, the magic starts. Our system breaks down your content and builds a story - scene by scene. In just seconds, it crafts six polished sections, each with its own visuals, voice-over, and title. The AI pitch deck generator or AI video resume builder (whichever you’re using) does all this automatically. No script writing, no guesswork - just structured, ready-to-go content that looks like you spent hours on it. Quick. Clean. Effortless.

3. Voice Cloning for Personalized Narration

Ever wished your video could actually sound like you? That’s exactly what this step does. Record a few seconds of your voice - just natural, nothing fancy - and our system clones it. Suddenly, your AI talking avatar starts speaking in your tone, your rhythm. It feels almost real.

The result? A professional video resume or pitch that sounds personal and alive. It adds warmth - the kind text alone can’t show. Whether you’re crafting a personal branding video or a video pitch deck, this little touch builds connection. It turns your message into something people actually feel.

4. Generate & Share

This is the best part - the moment everything comes together. With one click, your AI video platform transforms all that work into a polished, professional video. Smooth voice, clean visuals, perfect timing. It just feels done.

Once your AI talking avatar brings your message to life, you decide what happens next. Download the HD video and keep it for your portfolio - or share it instantly. LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter - anywhere your audience is. You can even send a secure link straight from the platform. No stress, no exporting headaches - just your story, ready to share with the world.

Why PortfolioVideo?

  • There’s no shortage of video tools out there - but nothing quite like PortfolioVideo. It’s more than software; it’s your stage. An AI-powered space where your ideas, skills, and story come alive. Whether you want to create personal branding videos, pitch your startup using our AI pitch deck generator, or share your journey through a professional video resume, it’s all built to make you stand out without touching a camera.

    In minutes, you get studio-level results. The AI talking avatar handles everything - tone, timing, presence. You just provide your story. From video personal branding to investor-ready decks, PortfolioVideo makes creation simple and powerful. It’s how professionals are building credibility, securing funding, and landing opportunities faster than ever.

  • It’s all powered by intelligence and design. The AI video resume builder turns static text into dynamic storytelling, while the video portfolio builder gives your work motion and depth.

    Entrepreneurs can craft an elevator pitch video, a startup pitch video, or a full video pitch deck that feels personal, not polished. And behind the curtain, the talking avatar creator and AI portfolio generator quietly tailor everything to fit your voice, your brand, your goals.

Presenter Mode - Interactive Presentations

Ever wished your video portfolio could do more than just play? Presenter Mode changes everything. It turns a simple video into an interactive experience - where slides, links, and visuals appear right when you talk about them. Think of it as storytelling in motion. You speak, and the content dances along with you - slides, web pages, even live embeds syncing perfectly with your video. It’s the kind of presentation that keeps people watching till the end.

Powerful and Easy-to-Use Video Editor

Once your video is ready, polish it like a pro - without being one. Our built-in editor makes refining your video portfolio surprisingly easy. Adjust text, swap visuals, and play around with clean templates until it looks and feels just right. The best part? Everything happens in real time. Whether it’s a professional video resume or a personal branding video, you’ll have full control, minus the complexity. It’s creative freedom, simplified.

Vibe Motion: Transform Your Professional Story Into Cinematic Motion

Simply upload your resume and a photo, and our AI instantly generates a stunning 5-second VFX motion video tailored to your specific industry and expertise. Choose from Professional, Casual, or Funny themes to perfectly match your brand tone and capture attention on LinkedIn, portfolios, and pitch decks. Stop relying on static documents, let Vibe Motion tell your story with high-end visual impact in just seconds.

No subscriptions or upfront fees-simply purchase credits and use them anytime for video generation, giving you complete flexibility and control over your costs.

Get started with just $10 for complete generation of multiple professional videos with multiple scenes (or) vibe motion videos. Experience high-quality video without breaking the bank.

🎉 New users get 100 credits ($10) free on signup,
so you can try PortfolioVideo at no risk.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is PortfolioVideo?

PortfolioVideo is your AI-powered creative partner - not just a tool. It helps you turn ideas into professional videos. Whether it’s a personal branding video, a polished video resume, or an investor pitch deck, everything happens in minutes. No cameras. No editing. Just your story, powered by AI talking avatars that look and sound real.

How does PortfolioVideo create professional videos?

It’s actually pretty simple. You upload your content - a resume, pitch script, or even a few notes - and the AI takes over. It creates scenes, scripts, and voice-overs automatically. The system uses your words, your tone, and wraps it all in a clean, professional layout. You can still tweak it anytime using our easy video editor.

What types of videos can I make?

Three main ones - personal branding videos for your online presence, AI video resumes to impress recruiters, and startup pitch decks that investors actually watch. Each is built from your content using AI, giving you fast, professional results with zero production stress.

Can I use my own voice?

Yep. Record a short sample and the system learns your tone - that’s voice cloning. Your video will sound like you’re really speaking. Or, if you prefer, pick from our collection of natural AI voices in different languages. Either way, it feels personal and human.

What is Presenter Mode?

Presenter Mode is where things get fun. Imagine your video playing alongside slides, web pages, or images that move in sync with what you’re saying. It feels interactive, almost like you’re giving a live presentation. Perfect for pitch decks, training, or showcasing your work dynamically.

Do I need editing skills or a camera?

Nope. None at all. The whole point of PortfolioVideo is to make video creation feel effortless. You upload your files, pick an avatar, and the AI handles the rest. If you want to fine-tune your video later, you can - but you don’t have to. It’s built for people who’d rather focus on their story, not the tech.

How long does it take to create a video?

Usually 5 to 10 minutes, tops. The AI scene builder works fast - turning your resume or deck into a full video with voice and visuals before you’ve even finished your coffee.

How can I share or download my videos?

You can download them as HD MP4 files or instantly share through a private link. Post to LinkedIn, YouTube, or wherever your audience hangs out. It’s literally one click - share and go.

What formats are supported?

Everything comes out as MP4, crisp and clean. Works perfectly on social platforms, websites, job boards, and even investor portals. Mobile or desktop - it’s smooth everywhere.

How much does it cost?

You can start free and make your first video without paying a dime. Paid plans start around five bucks - super flexible, no contracts or weird surprises.

Can I edit after creation?

Of course. The built-in editor lets you change text, replace visuals, adjust timing, and fine-tune your branding. Perfect for when you’re refreshing your pitch, updating your video resume, or tweaking your personal brand message.

What is Vibe Motion?

Vibe Motion is an AI-powered feature that turns your static professional documents into a cinematic experience. By uploading your resume or business document and a front face photo, our system generates a custom 5-second VFX motion video that visually represents your professional identity and personality.

Why is the vibe motion video only 5 seconds long?

We designed Vibe Motion to be a "Micro-Hook." In a fast-paced digital world, 5 seconds is the perfect length to capture attention without demanding too much time. It works like a dynamic profile picture-creating an instant impression before a recruiter or client even reads your name.

Who should use PortfolioVideo?

Honestly? Anyone who wants to stand out.

  • Job Seekers & Students – Make video resumes that actually get noticed.
  • Entrepreneurs & Founders – Use our AI pitch deck generator for impressive investor videos.
  • Professionals & Coaches – Build authority with personal branding videos for LinkedIn.
  • Freelancers & Creators – Showcase your portfolio through interactive storytelling.
  • Sales Teams – Craft quick, personalized video pitches for clients.
  • Career Changers – Reintroduce yourself with confidence using professional video resumes.

What makes PortfolioVideo different?

Unlike other video tools, PortfolioVideo focuses on you - your career, your ideas, your business. It merges personal branding, video resumes, and pitch decks into one place. The AI talking avatars do the heavy lifting, so even camera-shy professionals look confident and polished.

Are the AI avatars realistic?

Yes! They move naturally, speak clearly, and express emotion like real people. You pick the avatar, the style, and the vibe. The result feels surprisingly human - not robotic or over-produced.

Is my data safe?

Absolutely. Everything you upload - from resumes to voice samples - stays encrypted and private. We don’t share or reuse your data. It’s your story, and it stays yours.

Do video resumes really work?

They do. Candidates using AI video resumes see around a 10% higher callback rate. It’s not just about visuals - it’s the personality, the tone, the human touch. That’s what recruiters remember.

How do personal branding videos help my career?

They help people remember you. A short, authentic video does more than any text post ever could. It builds trust, shows your energy, and puts a face to your name. In short, it makes you stand out in a noisy feed.

What languages are supported?

Plenty. PortfolioVideo supports dozens of languages, so you can create video resumes, pitch decks, or personal branding content for global audiences - with authentic voice-overs in your preferred language.
